newsitem.title: USA: Key U.S. Democrat says opposes budget pact.
newsitem.headline: Key U.S. Democrat says opposes budget pact.

text.p: House Minority Leader Richard Gephardt said Tuesday he opposes the fiscal 1998 budget agreeement and urged House members to vote against it.

In remarks prepared for delivery during the House debate later in the day, the Missouri Democrat said, "This budget just isn't fair." He said he objected to cutting Medicare for the elderly while offering a tax cut to the wealthiest taxpayers.
He also said the budget agreement was based on "dubious assumptions" and will in fact increase the deficit after 2002.
